depiction_rules.notes: Keep one serene identity beside Shiva in stanza 8 and again in stanza 10.

visual_bible.appearance: Serene adult goddess with warm brown skin, dark hair, modest ochre jewelry and deep maroon sari with cream accents.
visual_bible.body: One natural two-armed, two-legged divine figure with connected limbs and proportionate anatomy.
visual_bible.style: Matte mineral mural pigments and restrained painted ochre details.
